title: Vesper and the Compass
author: Q. M. Almeida
blurb: Xanthe Blackwood, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
